AFM Cultural Documentation Project

By Anaguta Tradomodern Media

The AFM Cultural Documentation Project records video interviews, genealogical chants, and sacred rites with surviving village elders across Jos North.

What We Record

Oral histories, elder genealogies, clan boundaries, and ritual songs.

Impact

Over 60 hours of high-definition oral testimony have been preserved in digital archives to guarantee the transmission of Anaguta ancestral knowledge.
